title: Northgate Optical Guarantee Note: Where the Prescription-Change Window Starts
content:
The free window of a Northgate Optical prescription-change remake is counted from a window start. This note sets the window start where the job has had a non-adapt remake before the prescription-change remake, or where the job's prescription is old.

**Note.** Where the latest non-adapt remake on the job was opened before the prescription-change remake, the window start is the opening date of that latest non-adapt remake. Where the job carries no non-adapt remake, or its latest non-adapt remake was not opened before the prescription-change remake, and the job's prescription was issued more than 12 whole months before the prescription-change remake was opened, the window start is the prescription's issue date. Where neither holds, this note sets no window start.

**Records read.** The opening date of a remake is the date of its remake charge entry; a non-adapt remake carries the non-adapt reason and a prescription-change remake the prescription-change reason. The prescription's issue date is the one on the eyewear job. The prescription's age is counted in whole months from its issue date to the opening date of the prescription-change remake.

## Combinations

| Latest non-adapt remake opened before the prescription-change remake | Prescription issued more than 12 whole months before the prescription-change remake was opened | Window start under this note |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | opening date of the latest non-adapt remake |
| yes | no | opening date of the latest non-adapt remake |
| no (none on the job, or opened on or after that date) | yes | the prescription's issue date |
| no (none on the job, or opened on or after that date) | no | none set by this note |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical jobs)

- A non-adapt remake and a prescription-change remake opened on the same day: the non-adapt remake was not opened *before* the prescription-change remake.
- A prescription 12 whole months old when the prescription-change remake is opened is not more than 12 whole months old; at 13 whole months it is.
- Where a job has had two non-adapt remakes before the prescription-change remake, the later of the two gives the window start.
